context.note: Readiness/setup operations may resolve context before a financial dataset exists

errors.source: wire-v1.json/ErrorResponse plus mode/migration errors frozen at L3

operations.name: credentials.configure
operations.rule: verify owner before adopting; never content-script callable

operations.name: credentials.remove
operations.rule: fence new sends before deleting secret; retain journal/sentinel

operations.name: accounts.unlink
operations.rule: remove discovery membership; preserve canonical history

operations.name: capture.start
operations.rule: persist request before bank read; unknown ACK repeats original request_id

operations.name: capture.get
operations.rule: can persist lease expiration; does not dispatch a remote financial write

operations.name: capture.page
operations.rule: ACK only after page and revisions commit

operations.name: capture.stop
operations.rule: stop capture without erasing already authorized delivery

operations.name: mirror.refresh
operations.rule: raw response, cursor and projections publish atomically

operations.name: delivery.advance
operations.rule: sole new-transaction dispatch boundary, immutable intent before I/O

operations.name: reports.discrepancies
operations.rule: both unmatched sides; no upsert/delete; independent of blocked delivery

operations.name: migration.status
operations.rule: durable receipt; not authenticated by operation ID alone

operations.name: migration.transition
operations.rule: L3 defines full participant DTOs; no v1 hold bypass or automatic synchronization

schema_policy: Named existing wire models resolve in wire-v1.json; new runtime/migration DTOs are proposed operation boundaries, not implemented API models
